description: Live mid prices (midpoint of best bid/ask) for every asset Hyperliquid tracks — perps by symbol ("BTC", "ETH", ...) and spot pairs by numeric id ("@0", "@1", ...) — in one call, from Hyperliquid's public info API ({"type":"allMids"}). This is the cheapest way to get a current price: one request returns 1,000+ symbols. Pass `coin` to get just one symbol's mid price instead of the full map.

coin.description: Optional — return only this symbol's mid price, e.g. "BTC" or "ETH". Omit to get the full map.

name: hyperliquid_mids
title: Hyperliquid Mids
